definitions.explanation: In Japanese, traffic lights that show 'go' are called 青 even though they appear green.

{青|あお}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なったら→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{渡|わた}って→渡る：02441_wataru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please cross when it turns green.
I can see the blue sea.

examples.english: The light turned green, so I crossed the road.

notes:
{青|あお} covers a broader color range than English "blue" — it traditionally includes both blue and green.

COLOR RANGE:
In Japanese, {青|あお} historically covered both blue and green. Though ⟦{緑|みどり}→緑：00970_midori⟧ now covers green, {青|あお} is still used for:
- ⟦{青信号|あおしんごう}→青信号：21544_aoshingou⟧: green traffic light (called "blue")
- ⟦{青葉|あおば}→青葉：20092_aoba⟧: green leaves
- ⟦{青|あお}りんご→青りんご：27445_aoringo⟧: green apple

USAGE:
{青|あお} itself is a noun — the name of the color. It is what you use when the color is the topic or the thing being named: {青|あお}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧ (I like blue), ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{青|あお}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧ (the color is blue).

To describe a noun directly, Japanese normally uses the i-adjective ⟦{青|あお}い→青い：00586_aoi⟧, not {青|あお}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: ⟦{青|あお}い→青い：00586_aoi⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧ is the ordinary way to say "a blue car". {青|あお}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun does occur, but it names the color as a category or shade ({青|あお}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧ — the clothes in blue, e.g. picking one from several colors).

For traffic signals only the noun {青|あお} is used, with ⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ or ⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧ marked by ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: ⟦{信号|しんごう}→信号：03258_shingou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{青|あお}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧.
- ⟦{青|あお}い→青い：00586_aoi⟧: also means inexperienced, immature (⟦{青|あお}い→青い：00586_aoi⟧⟦{考|かんが}え→考え：00855_kangae⟧ — naive thinking)
- ⟦{青|あお}ざめる→青ざめる：14612_aozameru⟧: to turn pale (with fear/shock)
- ⟦{青春|せいしゅん}→青春：14613_seishun⟧: youth (literally "blue spring")

FORMS:
- Noun: {青|あお} (the color blue)
- の-adjective: {青|あお}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧ (blue sky)
- い-adjective: ⟦{青|あお}い→青い：00586_aoi⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧ (blue sky)
